parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =status IN (Done, Resolved, Closed, Released, Deployed, "Ready for Prod") AND project IN (IA, DATA, POD1, POD2, POD3, POD4) AND resolutiondate >= "{{ $json.startDate }}" AND resolutiondate <= "{{ $json.endDate }}" AND type IN (Bug, Story, Task) ORDER BY resolutiondate DESC
